register.labelZh: CROSS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cross over 能幫助你描述橫過馬路、橋樑、路徑及其他地方的日常動作。；cross off 可以表示工作已完成、某個項目不再需要,或某人不再包括在名單內。；cross out 和 cross through 可以劃掉錯誤的字詞、日期、答案或句子,毋須重寫全部內容。；人們填寫表格、修改文字或逐項處理清單時,經常會使用這些 CROSS 片語動詞。
register.summaryEn: Cross over helps you describe everyday movements across roads, bridges, paths and other places. Cross off lets you show that a job is finished, an item is no longer needed or a person is no longer included. Cross out and cross through let you remove a wrong word, date, answer or sentence without rewriting everything. These CROSS expressions often appear when people complete forms, edit writing or work through a list.
